name: sentio-connector
description: Wallet balances, token prices, portfolio value and DeFi positions from Sentio, via the hosted Sentio Connect MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Ask about the wallets you track: native and token balances valued in USD, token spot prices, total portfolio value across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum and Sui, and cross-chain DeFi positions (lending, staking, LPs, rewards). Sign in once with your Sentio Connect account; the plugin only reads data and can add addresses to your own tracked list.
defaultPrompt: What is the total USD value of all the wallets I track?
Show the token balances of vitalik.eth on Ethereum.
List my DeFi positions on Base and Arbitrum.
